what_its_for: Rimegepant is used to treat migraine headaches with or without aura in adults. It can also be used to help prevent migraines from happening. It works by blocking a protein in your brain called CGRP that causes migraine pain and symptoms.
how_to_take: Place one tablet on or under your tongue and let it dissolve completely. Do not swallow it whole or chew it. You do not need water to take this medicine. Open the blister pack by peeling back the foil — do not push the tablet through the foil, as this can break it. Handle the tablet gently and place it in your mouth right away.
dosing: For treating a migraine: Take 1 tablet (75 mg) as soon as your migraine starts. You may take a second dose at least 2 hours after the first if your migraine comes back, but do not take more than 2 tablets in any 24-hour period. For preventing migraines: Take 1 tablet every other day (every 48 hours). Do not take it more often than once every 48 hours when using it for prevention.
missed_dose: If you are using rimegepant to prevent migraines and you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. Then wait at least 48 hours before taking your next dose. If you are using it to treat a migraine, take it as soon as your migraine starts. Do not double up on doses.
storage: Store rimegepant at room temperature, between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C). Keep tablets in their original blister packaging until you are ready to use them. Protect them from moisture and heat. Keep this medicine out of reach of children.
what_to_avoid: Avoid taking rimegepant with grapefruit juice, as it can increase the amount of medicine in your body and raise your risk of side effects. Tell your doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines you take, especially antifungal medicines like ketoconazole or itraconazole, certain antibiotics like clarithromycin, HIV medicines, or seizure medicines like rifampin, as these can affect how rimegepant works. Avoid taking other migraine medicines (such as triptans or ergotamines) at the same time without talking to your doctor first.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor or get medical help right away if you experience: a serious allergic reaction such as swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat, trouble breathing, or a severe skin rash; shortness of breath; nausea or vomiting that is severe or does not go away; unusual or worsening headaches; or any side effects that worry you or do not go away. Also tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding before taking this medicine.
when_it_works: Rimegepant starts working within 1 to 2 hours after you take it for a migraine. Many people feel relief from their migraine pain within 2 hours. When used to prevent migraines, it may take a few weeks of regular every-other-day dosing before you notice fewer migraines.
special_populations: Pregnancy and breastfeeding: Talk to your doctor before using rimegepant if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, as its safety has not been fully established in these situations. Liver or kidney problems: If you have severe liver disease, you should not use rimegepant. If you have severe kidney disease, use it with caution and talk to your doctor. Older adults: Rimegepant can generally be used in older adults, but tell your doctor about all your other medical conditions and medicines.
